verdict.rationale: The Typesense Cloud MCP server docs say you decide what the agent is allowed to do when you connect it and can disconnect it at any time. Typesense Cloud also lists Role-Based Access Control. Together these point to some least-privilege control over agent access, though how granular it is goes undocumented here. The only evidence on per-index keys is an old community request noting index-restricted API keys were not yet available at the time, and nothing in the pack shows they have shipped since. Missing for 10: documented scoped API key creation (per-action/per-collection permissions, expiry), detail on what MCP connection permissions can be restricted, coverage for self-hosted deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
